strings: After m_c forgot to properly care for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt with the herbal paste, the rash that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/suffer/suffers} from has come back worse with a vengeance.
Much to the frustration of both r_c0 and m_c, the rash on m_c has spread and returned to more places across {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body.
Wincing m_c begs off patrol to go visit r_c0 for help putting {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} herbal paste on the areas that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just can't reach.
